svg.title: Where d, z, and m enter Kyber's key generation, encapsulation, and decapsulation
svg.desc: Three-column flowchart: KeyGen uses d and z as random inputs; Encaps uses m as random input; Decaps reuses z only as a fallback for implicit rejection when re-encryption doesn't match the ciphertext.
svg.text: Amber = random input from DRBG · Gray = deterministic step · Teal = final output
